svg.title: equivalent-width
svg.desc: Wλ = ∫[1−Fλ/Fc]dλ; 1 Å = 1000 mÅ. The center is a hypothetical 5000 Å (500 nm) line. Depth and width are independent synthetic teaching inputs. Gaussian full EW = depth × sigma × sqrt(2π); FWHM = 2 sqrt(2 ln 2) sigma and is not EW. A finite window can lose area. Continuum errors can add or subtract area, including a signed negative result. The Lorentzian width control is HWHM, not sigma. Sources: https://www.astro.uvic.ca/~tatum/stellatm/atm11.pdf
